description: Required output format for mutation analysis results.

schema.total_mutants: int: total number of mutants from manifest
schema.killed: int: mutants detected (test failure or timeout) by test suite
schema.survived: int: mutants not detected, includes equivalent and non-equivalent
schema.equivalent: int: survived mutants classified as semantically equivalent to original

operator_counts.AOR: int: Arithmetic Operator Replacement mutant count
operator_counts.ROR: int: Relational Operator Replacement mutant count
operator_counts.LCR: int: Logical Connector Replacement mutant count
operator_counts.AOD: int: Arithmetic Operator Deletion mutant count
operator_counts.UOI: int: Unary Operator Insertion mutant count

schema.kill_matrix: dict: maps each killed mutant ID to the list of test function names that killed it
schema.subsuming_mutants: list of str: IDs of dynamically subsuming mutants — killed mutants whose kill set is not a proper superset of any other killed mutant's kill set
schema.equivalent_mutants: list of objects {id: str, reason: str} for each equivalent mutant with justification
schema.surviving_non_equivalent: list of str: IDs of survived mutants classified as non-equivalent (test gaps)
schema.branch_coverage_original: float: branch coverage percentage of test_basic.py against target/mathlib.py, measured with coverage.py branch=True (0.0-100.0)
schema.branch_coverage_enhanced: float: branch coverage percentage of test_basic.py + test_enhanced.py combined against target/mathlib.py (0.0-100.0)

notes: A mutant is 'killed' if any test in the suite fails or times out when run against the mutated code.
A mutant M1 'dynamically subsumes' M2 if T(M1) is a proper subset of T(M2), where T(M) is the set of tests killing M.
A mutant is 'subsuming' if no other killed mutant has a kill set that is a proper subset of its kill set.
Indistinguishable mutants (same kill set) are all considered subsuming if none has a proper subset.
Enhanced tests in test_enhanced.py must pass on the original (unmutated) code and kill all surviving_non_equivalent mutants.
Branch coverage must be measured using coverage.py with branch=True against /app/target/mathlib.py.

The subsumption DOT file must represent the transitive reduction of the subsumption partial order: nodes are killed mutant IDs, directed edges M1 -> M2 mean M1 directly subsumes M2 (T(M1) ⊂ T(M2) with no intermediate M3 where T(M1) ⊂ T(M3) ⊂ T(M2)).
The subsumption PNG must be rendered from the DOT file using the graphviz dot command.
